'''Stinkfish''' were [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The stinkfish exuded a [[Poison/Legends|poison]] as a form of defence that could render individuals unconscious.<ref name="BGS" />
